name: Hulkbuster

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Zırh kıran şampiyon kullan, yoksa yetenek azaltma ve şok hasarı ölümcül olabilir. Bonus-nötralize edenler de iyi. Sadece şok immün ama zırh kırma/nötralize'siz şampiyon kullanma.
signatureAbility:
Veronica Mk Ii
100% chance to activate a Self-Repair Buff lasting 12 seconds and recovering [22,830.08 - 64,209.79] Health. This Buff is lost if Hulkbuster is Stunned.

immunityDetails:

abilitySections.title: While Fighting as an Attacker
content: Enter Giant-Buster Mode, granting the following:
Up to +[2,664.25] Attack rating based on how large the opponent is.
+[2,983.96] Attack rating for each Shock effect on the opponent.

abilitySections.title: While Fighting as a Defender
content: Enter Iron Wall Mode, enhancing Hulkbuster's defensive abilities.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Gain an indefinite Armor Up, granting +[485.29] Armor rating.

abilitySections.title: Start of Fight & Every 15 Seconds
content: Gain an indefinite Armor Up, granting +[485.29] Armor rating.
Max Stacks in Giant-Buster: 2.
Max Stacks in Iron Wall: 4.

abilitySections.title: Brought Below 15% Health - Once Per Fight
content: Gain an indefinite Armor Up, granting +[485.29] Armor rating.
If in Iron Wall, gain a second Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Fighting Non-Cosmic Champions
content: For each Armor Up Buff Hulkbuster gains the following benefits:
+[1,178.57] Energy Resistance.
+[114.58] Critical Damage Rating.
Incoming Bleed & Poison Debuffs suffer -25% Potency.
Enemy attacks suffer -20% Offensive Ability Accuracy.
Enemy attacks suffer -[179.91] Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: When Struck by Critical Hits
content: 60% chance to consume 1 Armor Up Buff to inflict a Shock Debuff, dealing [6,927.05] Energy Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff, dealing [5,861.35] Energy Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [4,125] for 20 seconds.
100% chance to gain an Unblockable Buff, lasting 1 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to Stun for 1.5 second(s).
If the opponent's block is broken by the attack, all of Hulkbuster's Armor Up Buffs are consumed to add +1.25 second(s) duration to the Stun Debuff for each Armor Up consumed this way.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If the opponents block is broken by this attack, all Beam attacks have a 100% chance to inflict Power Burn, draining 1 Bar(s) of Power per hit and inflicting direct damage proportional to the Power drained.
100% chance to Power Lock, severing the target's flow of Power for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This Attack Drains 50% of the Opponent's current Power.
Inflicts up to 3 Shock Debuffs, with each having a 80% chance to activate, dealing [5,861.35] Energy Damage over 20 seconds.
Unblockable Buffs triggered during this attack gain +4.5 seconds duration.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Veronica Mk Ii
content: 100% chance to activate a Self-Repair Buff lasting 12 seconds and recovering [22,830.08 - 64,209.79] Health. This Buff is lost if Hulkbuster is Stunned.
Giant-Buster: +[2,664.25 - 12,255.51] Attack rating while Self-Repair is active.
Iron Wall: +[13 - 45]% Self-Repair Potency.
